action_instruction: Checking whether any cart line is present in the cart contents
intent: whether any cart line is present in the cart contents

action_params.condition: at least one other cart line still appears on the cart page
action_params.query: whether any cart line is present in the cart contents

action_instruction: Checking whether each remaining cart line shows an item name, unit price, quantity, and line-item subtotal
intent: whether each remaining cart line shows an item name, unit price, quantity, and line-item subtotal

action_params.condition: each remaining cart line still shows item name, unit price, quantity, and line-item subtotal
action_params.query: whether each remaining cart line shows an item name, unit price, quantity, and line-item subtotal
action_params.code_js: (() => { const lines = Array.from(el(7)?.querySelectorAll('.cart-line') || []); return lines.length > 0 && lines.every(line => { const txt = line.innerText; const prices = (txt.match(/\$\d+(?:\.\d{2})?/g) || []).length; const hasName = !!line.querySelector('h3, .item-name, .product-name') || /[A-Za-z]/.test(txt.replace(/\$\d+(?:\.\d{2})?/g,'')); const qtyText = Array.from(line.querySelectorAll('button, span, div')).some(n => n.textContent.trim() === '1') || /\b\d+\b/.test(txt); return hasName && prices >= 2 && qtyText; }); })()

action_instruction: Checking whether the cart total amount matches the sum of the displayed remaining line-item subtotals
intent: whether the cart total amount matches the sum of the displayed remaining line-item subtotals

action_params.condition: the cart-wide total matches the sum of the displayed remaining line-item subtotals
action_params.query: whether the cart total amount matches the sum of the displayed remaining line-item subtotals
action_params.code_js: (() => { const lines = Array.from(el(7)?.querySelectorAll('.cart-line') || []); const sum = lines.reduce((acc, line) => { const prices = line.innerText.match(/\$\d+(?:\.\d{2})?/g) || []; const subtotal = prices[prices.length - 1]; return acc + (subtotal ? parseFloat(subtotal.replace('$','')) : 0); }, 0); const totalText = Array.from(el(7)?.querySelectorAll('*')).map(n => n.textContent.trim()).find(t => /^Total:\s*\$\d+(?:\.\d{2})?$/.test(t)); const total = totalText ? parseFloat(totalText.match(/\$\d+(?:\.\d{2})?/)[0].replace('$','')) : NaN; return sum === total; })()

action_instruction: Checking whether the removed product still appears among the cart lines

action_params.query: whether the removed product still appears among the cart lines
